Windows Server 2016 - Microsoft Lifecycle

Windows Server 2016 follows the Fixed Lifecycle Policy.

| Listing | Start Date | Mainstream End Date | Extended End Date |
| Windows Server 2016 Datacenter | Oct 15, 2016 | Jan 11, 2022 | Jan 12, 2027 |
| Windows Server 2016 Standard | Oct 15, 2016 | Jan 11, 2022 | Jan 12, 2027 |

Releases

| Version | Start Date | End Date |
| Original Release | Oct 15, 2016 | Oct 9, 2018 |
